title: MarkDeck
content: React, Vite, and TypeScript application that converts LLM-generated Markdown into structured slide decks. Features a Node.js/Express/MySQL API, RBAC sharing, Dockerized services, CI/CD, and Grafana/Loki observability.

title: SREs
content: Python, LangGraph, and LangChain agents investigate simulated production incidents using logs, metrics, and service events. Includes human-approved remediation, a Next.js interface, FastAPI, MongoDB, Prometheus, Loki, Docker Compose, and Dokploy deployment.
